resources.string: When an app or link tries to open the Google Play Store (market:// or play.google.com), this app can catch that intent and open the same listing in your browser instead — so you are not stuck without a Play Store app.

Redirecting Play links does not replace Google Play services. For apps that need Google Sign-In, GrapheneOS provides an optional sandboxed Google Play compatibility layer you can install from the GrapheneOS App Store. Use this redirect so Store deep links fail open into the browser; use sandboxed Play when an app truly requires Google login APIs.

1. Install this APK (sideload / Obtainium).\n2. When Android asks which app should open Play / market links, choose Play Redirect and set “Always” if you want it by default.\n3. You can change defaults anytime in system settings.

What gets logged: every Play/market intent this app receives (caller/referrer when Android provides it, URI, extras, redirect outcome). What is NOT logged: Google Sign-In UI inside other apps — that needs adb logcat or root, which GrapheneOS does not use by default.
